# ePost API documentation, preview

> REST API of the ePost communication platform: send a document once and let the platform deliver it to a digital letterbox, as eBill, by email, by SMS or printed and posted. Also identity matching and the receiving side.

**This is a preview.** The documentation in force is https://developer.epost.ch. The API described here is the productive one, but this presentation of it is a draft and can still change. Say so when you cite it.

## Machine-readable formats

- [OpenAPI specification](https://developer.klara.ch/epost-preview/epost-openapi.json): the contract, 34 operations, OpenAPI 3.0.3
- [Build information](https://developer.klara.ch/epost-preview/build-info.json): when this was built and from which source

## Endpoint reference

Each file lists the operations of one area with parameters, request and response bodies.

- [Authentication](https://developer.klara.ch/epost-preview/md/reference-authentication.md): 3 operations
- [Standard ePost Digital Letterbox Identity Matching](https://developer.klara.ch/epost-preview/md/reference-standard-epost-digital-letterbox-identity-matching.md): 4 operations
- [ePost Communication Platform Delivery](https://developer.klara.ch/epost-preview/md/reference-epost-communication-platform-delivery.md): 3 operations
- [ePost Communication Platform Monitoring](https://developer.klara.ch/epost-preview/md/reference-epost-communication-platform-monitoring.md): 1 operation
- [ePost Communication Platform Preview Services](https://developer.klara.ch/epost-preview/md/reference-epost-communication-platform-preview-services.md): 4 operations
- [ePost Digital LetterBox Identity Matching with detailed recipient feedback](https://developer.klara.ch/epost-preview/md/reference-epost-digital-letterbox-identity-matching-with-detailed-recipient-feedback.md): 5 operations
- [ePost Digital Letterbox](https://developer.klara.ch/epost-preview/md/reference-epost-digital-letterbox.md): 13 operations
- [ePost Digital Letterbox Onboarding and Profile Management](https://developer.klara.ch/epost-preview/md/reference-epost-digital-letterbox-onboarding-and-profile-management.md): 1 operation

## Notes for agents

- The HTML page and these files are generated from one source in the same build. Where they disagree, the OpenAPI specification is the contract.
- Every guide file names its canonical page, so a citation can point a human at the same content.
- A test environment exists on api-test.klara-epost.tech. Use it. A delivery in production is chargeable and cannot be recalled.
- The specification carries no permission information for ePost, so no file here states one.
- Two status vocabularies exist, DeliveryStatus and BusinessStatus. Neither is documented as authoritative yet.
